title: Capture source system lineage on ingest
description: Loads customer rows without recording where they came from.
issue_description: Downstream debugging becomes harder when analysts cannot trace a row back to its source system or file.
issue_suggestion: Preserve source metadata such as system, file, or batch id alongside the normalized row.

title: Use explicit schemas when reading CSV inputs
description: Lets the CSV reader infer all column types automatically.
issue_title: Schema inference can drift across files
issue_description: Type inference may vary between batches and create unstable downstream types.
issue_suggestion: Provide an explicit schema for production ingestion jobs.

title: Do not overwrite partition history unintentionally
description: Writes one daily partition using overwrite mode on the whole table path.
issue_title: Overwrite semantics can delete unrelated partitions
issue_description: A partition load can erase more history than intended if overwrite scope is too broad.
issue_suggestion: Overwrite only the target partition or use dynamic partition overwrite safely.

title: Normalize identifiers before cross-system joins
description: Joins CRM ids and billing ids without consistent casing.
code: SELECT * FROM crm c JOIN billing b ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id;
issue_title: Join keys may not be normalized consistently
issue_description: Case or formatting mismatches across systems can silently drop otherwise matching rows.
issue_suggestion: Normalize shared identifiers before joining datasets from multiple systems.

title: Detect unexpected schema additions early
description: Reads partner payloads and ignores extra columns silently.
issue_title: New source fields arrive without detection
issue_description: Silent schema growth can signal upstream changes that deserve review or explicit handling.
issue_suggestion: Alert when unexpected columns appear instead of ignoring them silently.

title: Preserve ordering keys for reproducible incremental merges
description: Merges CDC rows without using sequence numbers.
issue_description: Out-of-order CDC events can produce the wrong final row if sequence or version keys are ignored.
issue_suggestion: Use a source sequence number or version to order conflicting changes deterministically.

title: Do not aggregate before handling late corrections
description: Rolls up daily revenue directly from raw append-only events.
code:
def daily_revenue(events):
    return sum(event['amount'] for event in events if event['date'] == today())
issue_title: Correction and reversal events are not modeled
issue_description: Simple rollups can overstate metrics when the source emits later cancels or corrections.
issue_suggestion: Model reversals and adjustments before publishing aggregates.

title: Use stable batch ids for replay safety
description: Names output files with the current timestamp only.
issue_description: Timestamp-only naming makes it harder to connect outputs to a specific source batch or replay attempt.
issue_suggestion: Include a stable source or orchestration batch id in the output naming scheme.

title: Partition by query pattern, not writer convenience
description: Writes event data partitioned by ingestion worker id.
issue_title: Partitioning does not match analytical access patterns
issue_description: Data layout should optimize common read filters, not whichever field is convenient at write time.
issue_suggestion: Partition by date or another common query dimension instead.

title: Quarantine malformed records with context
description: Drops bad JSON rows without keeping the original payload.
issue_description: Without the original payload and error details, bad rows are hard to inspect or replay later.
issue_suggestion: Store malformed input and failure details in a quarantine sink.
